independentReview.reason: The frozen rule requires all genuine disputes even in excluded records. Restoring the omitted Hanoi dispute to independent diagnostic review complied with that rule: raw rows and original invalid status were preserved, and no primary admission or numeric repair occurred. The reviewer returned ineligible outcomes for the aggregate, all 37 constituents and the dispute after opening its source. Source ambiguity remains factually unresolved, but eligibility is resolved by exclusion, as permitted; it is not an inaccessible or unfinished review. An additional burger-description ambiguity noticed during that same review was also excluded. N=0 means no random sample was due and explicitly fails feasibility; it is not evidence of broad review coverage.
independentReview.audit: Offline SHA256 checks matched every execution-summary input artifact and returned-response validation hash. All 37 selected diagnostic rows exactly matched raw objects; every required row, aggregate and dispute had an outcome. This audit does not independently certify external source truth.

sourceAcquisition: Hanoi, Bandipur and Oaxaca returned raw menus; missing mandatory-charge normalization is independent of formatting. Bandipur also records incomplete exposed menu sections and uncertain geography for one venue; Oaxaca records currency/unit/geography uncertainties. None may be admitted by inference.
Current-undated menus are allowed but give limited temporal certainty. No complete daily basket was acquired or required.
Hotel search/open limitations and mismatched or blank dates prevented matched hotel coverage.
serializationAndHashes: First-wave collector instructions under-specified exact validator conventions for ranked-result fields, structured IDs, boolean operator status and terminal enums; raw outputs failed multiple checks. Some errors also concern missing source evidence, so they cannot all be dismissed as superficial formatting.

The later delivery clarification made existing mechanical requirements explicit; no first-wave retry, price repair, query change or relaxed threshold occurred. Envelope-version differences prevent attributing apparent later schema compliance to estimator improvement.
Bled hotel task hash differs in casing only. Preserve invalid status; even accepting equivalent digest bytes would yield no matched offer.
runtime: Bled, Kyoto and Copenhagen menu artifacts are absent after interruption; actual source actions and task completion are unknown. Each is charged its full four-action allocation.

Bled accounting began before dispatch while the coordinator audited serialization. Queue delay and interruption are not model latency; elapsed journal intervals cannot prove continuous worker execution or timeout compliance.

prospectiveLessons: If separately authorized, make exact delivery schemas and hash serialization explicit before freezing; validate with synthetic fixtures rather than actual-city retries.
Align coordinator accounting with actual dispatch and persist terminal/missing artifacts robustly; record interruption separately from model latency.
Any future feasibility design should confront charge-basis availability and exact-date booking access prospectively. Do not infer charges, substitute easier cities or relax this gate.
Retain the all-disputes rule for excluded observations in tooling, with diagnostics segregated from random primary eligibility.
